steps.note: Open the existing prepared closed RFQ project instead of searching or creating another event.
Enable the required eRFX project configuration before accessing the prepared event.
Navigate to the RFQ stage whose Settings menu contains Recreate Order.
Open the RFQ stage action and leave the Recreate Order dialog open.
Confirm the Recreate Order dialog offers the expected Create Order action.
Submit the action with its defaults.
Verify the recreate action did not produce an application error.
